summary.text: Alec Ryncavage is the Republican incumbent, in office since December 1, 2022, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 119, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as entrepreneur.

paragraphs.text: Alec Ryncavage graduated from Wyoming Valley West High School in 2019, and his career experience includes founding Offprem.

After taking office on December 1, 2022, his 2023-2024 committee assignments, as listed by Ballotpedia, were Consumer Protection & Professional Licensure (subcommittee chair on Technology), Gaming Oversight, and Local Government.
